meta.name: learn
meta.description: Extract lessons from a retrospective and fold improvements into project-local skill/agent extensions under _booping/. Use after /retro writes a retrospective.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从回顾中提取经验并改进本地技能扩展
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队做完回顾后想把改进落地到日常开发工具中
copy.tagline_en: Extract lessons from retrospectives and fold improvements into local skill extensions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team wants to turn retrospective insights into actionable skill improvements

howto.what: 从回顾文档中提取经验教训，并将改进措施写入项目本地的技能或代理扩展文件中。
howto.when: 在 /retro 命令写完回顾文档后，用户调用 learn 技能时触发。

say.text: 从这份回顾中提取教训并改进。
say.note: 技能会读取回顾文件并生成改进。

say.text: 把这次回顾的改进点写入本地扩展。
say.note: 技能会将改进写入 _booping/ 目录。

howto.what_en: Extract lessons from a retrospective and fold improvements into project-local skill/agent extensions under _booping/.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /retro writes a retrospective, when the user invokes the learn skill.

say_en.text: Extract lessons from this retro and improve.
say_en.note: Skill reads the retro file and generates improvements.

say_en.text: Write the retro improvements into local extensions.
